title: NASA-JAXA XRISM Mission Sees Pulsar Gathering Companion’s ‘Wind’
summary: Using data from the Japan-led XRISM (X-ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission) observatory, astronomers have directly observed a giant star’s outflow, called a stellar wind, being captured by its compact companion and providing the power source for strong X-ray flares.
